item.title: Last chance to buy today ahead of record date! BN Agrochem announces split, stock delivers 28% return in 2 weeks
item.description: BN Agrochem shares were in focus ahead of the November 16 record date for a 1:10 stock split. Under the T+1 settlement cycle, November 13 was the final day to buy shares and qualify. The stock hit its sixth consecutive upper circuit, despite steep declines over the past year.

item.description: Top stocks to watch today: Vodafone Idea, Ola Electric Mobility, IRCTC, Grasim Industries, Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles are among the shares in focus on Friday.

item.description: Stock market prediction for Friday, 13 November, 2026: Gift Nifty was trading around the 25,266.50 level, down nearly 34.50 points or 0.12% from the Nifty futures’ previous close, indicating a muted start for the Indian stock market indices.

item.description: NVIDIA stock crash: AMD shares climbed around 5.86%, while Broadcom advanced 5.54% during Thursday's trading session.

item.title: GPU Financing Filters Further Into ABS With Planned Newton Deal
item.description: Newton Commercial Finance, a joint venture between Apple Bank and Eagle Point Credit Management, is in early talks with investors about a potential $180 million bond offering partly backed by artificial intelligence chip loans.

item.title: Yen Falls to Cusp of 160 Level, Fanning Intervention Risk
item.description: The yen slid to the verge of 160 to the dollar, a key threshold that’s raising the specter that policymakers in Tokyo will swoop in again to defend the currency.

item.title: The Yen Is Becoming Too Hard for Some Investors to Trade
item.description: After a year of wild swings, the yen surprised traders by settling into a tight range clustered near 158 per dollar over recent months. But on Wednesday it broke out again, unexpectedly weakening toward 160.

item.title: Anthropic’s IPO Is About Six Times Oversubscribed
item.description: Anthropic PBC’s initial public offering has drawn about six times the orders for the shares available, according to people familiar with the matter, as interest increases for potentially the biggest first-time share sale ever.

item.title: Trafigura Is Key Player in LME Aluminum Squeeze With China Trade
item.description: Trafigura Group has bought up significant volumes of aluminum on the London Metal Exchange, making it a key player in a historic squeeze as inventories of the metal plunge.

item.title: Rail Vikas Nigam in focus today after mixed Q2 performance; stock down 68% from record peak
item.description: Rail Vikas Nigam reported Q2 FY27 net profit growth of 10% to ₹253.71 crore, despite an 8.24% revenue decline. Operating profit rose 19.51%. For H1, net profit increased 13.25% and operating profit surged 62.29%, while revenue was nearly flat.

item.title: Nvidia stock crash: Short seller flagged Jensen Huang’s close ties to Alice Huang months before CEO’s resignation
item.description: A May report by short seller Culper Research questioned Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s ties to Megaspeed executive Alice Huang and raised concerns about Nvidia’s China-linked supply chain.&nbsp;

item.title: Paytm shares at ₹1,925, close in on IPO listing-day high after 100% rally from March lows. What drove the recovery?
item.description: Paytm shares rose 7.3% to ₹1,925, their highest close since listing in 2021, amid optimism that merchant discount rate charges could lift margins. The company reported September-quarter profit of ₹226 crore, while mutual fund ownership reached a record 21.17%.

item.title: Laurus Labs, Gland Pharma, Piramal, Divi's Labs: 4 drug manufacturing stocks rally up to 89% in 6 months - Upside ahead?
item.description: Pharma stocks, particularly CDMO companies, have surged over the past six months amid optimism about quarterly results. Laurus Labs led with an 88.64% gain, followed by Gland Pharma at 80.36%, Divi’s Laboratories at 72.35% and Piramal Pharma at 38.65%.&nbsp;

item.title: Anthropic IPO: Who is Krishna Rao? Meet the CFO whose $1.30 stock options could unlock a ₹7,000 crore fortune
item.description: Anthropic is preparing an IPO that could value the company at up to $1.4 trillion. CFO Krishna Rao’s 9.497 million shares, acquired through options with a $1.30 exercise price, could gain about 5,600% at the proposed $74 share price. The company plans to list on Nasdaq as ANT.

item.title: Meesho block deal: SVF II Meerkat to offload 1% stake at ₹246 apiece; deal size ₹1,174 crore
item.description: Meesho shares may be in focus after a SoftBank affiliate reportedly planned to sell a 1% stake for about ₹1,174 crore at a 3.1% discount.&nbsp;

item.title: Nvidia stock plunges 14% to over one-year low as Jensen Huang quits amid affair; market cap falls below $4 trillion
item.description: Nvidia shares fell 14.3% to $148.80 after CEO Jensen Huang resigned, ending his 33-year tenure. CFO Colette Kress was named interim CEO as the board searches for a permanent successor. Harvey C. Jones was appointed the company’s first board chairman.

item.title: ₹150 per share dividend: Check record date of firm behind Jockey in India - Mega payout after Q2 results 2026
item.description: Page Industries declared a second interim dividend of ₹150 per share for FY27, with November 18, 2026, as the record date and payment due by December 11.&nbsp;

item.title: HAL shares edge lower after Q2 results despite 16% YoY profit growth; why did investors turn cautious? Decoded
item.description: HAL shares fell 2% after September-quarter EBITDA missed estimates, despite net profit rising 16% year on year to ₹1,936 crore and revenue growing 14.9%. EBITDA margins narrowed to 24.1%.

item.title: Oil India dividend, Q2 results 2026: PSU giant announces interim payout as profit more than doubles - Check record date
item.description: Oil India’s standalone Q2 FY27 net profit more than doubled year over year to ₹2,259.42 crore, while revenue rose to ₹8,071.33 crore. The board approved an interim dividend of ₹7 per share, with November 20 as the record date.

item.title: Up in 8 of last 10 sessions, HDFC Bank share price jumps 22% in this period - Why should you still buy the bank stock?
item.description: HDFC Bank shares have rebounded about 22% from their 52-week low in 10 trading sessions, adding roughly ₹2.2 lakh crore to market value. Analysts cite improving operations and resilient asset quality, while cautioning that a decisive close above ₹820 is needed to confirm further momentum.

item.title: Foreign inflows lift Indian stocks' dollar returns above rupee gains as currency rebounds
item.description: Foreign portfolio investors have net bought shares worth ₹60,698 crore in the first 11 days of November, the highest monthly inflow so far since December 2023, NSDL data.

item.title: Page Industries shares plunge 13% as higher RM costs hit Q2 profitability; can festive demand drive a recovery?
item.description: Page Industries shares fell 13% to their lowest level since April after higher input costs limited profit growth in Q2 FY27. Revenue rose 11.5% to ₹1,439.6 crore, while profit after tax increased 4% to ₹202.5 crore. The company expects festive demand and new products to support growth.

item.title: UPI MDR rollout after Diwali: What it means for Paytm, MobiKwik and Pine Labs | What investors should know
item.description: A new MDR framework for some UPI merchant payments could give payment companies a recurring revenue stream, replacing reliance on discretionary incentives. Eligible transactions above ₹2,000 will generally attract a 0.4% fee, subject to caps and exemptions.

item.title: Maritime PSU face-off: SCI vs GRSE - Which PSU stock to buy after Q2 results? Profit, dividend, and technical targets
item.description: Shipping Corporation of India’s Q2 FY27 net profit rose 205% to ₹577.76 crore, while Garden Reach Shipbuilders &amp; Engineers’ profit increased 12% to ₹172 crore. Both PSU stocks rallied recently, with analysts noting recovery signals in SCI and potential fresh-entry opportunities in GRSE.

item.title: AI stock Nvidia resumes losing run as brokerages turn bearish; Jensen Huang exit fears, board probe spook investors
item.description: Brokerages have cut Nvidia price targets and downgraded the stock amid an investigation into allegations involving CEO Jensen Huang and uncertainty over his future.&nbsp;

item.title: Bitcoin slips below $74,000 mark, experts explain the factors influencing the cryptocurrency this week
item.description: Bitcoin fell 0.4% to $73,344.71 on 12 November, while the broader crypto market declined 0.78% to $2.43 trillion. Analysts cited inflation concerns, a stronger dollar, ETF withdrawals and shifting investment toward AI as pressures.

item.title: IPO listing: This robotics firm's shares jump 83% in exchange debut; 3 Indian stocks to watch | Returns, other details
item.description: Amicro Technology shares jumped nearly 83% in early Hong Kong trading, spotlighting robotics and automation. With Amicro's bumper listing, let's take a look at three small cap stocks in India with exposure to this emerging theme.

item.title: India's Next Billion-Dollar IPO? Coal India subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields in line after Jio, NSE - key things to know
item.description: Coal India subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields is preparing for a potential IPO of up to $1 billion, with Sebi observations received on November 4. The offer will be an offer for sale of a 10% stake by Coal India, and could launch in late November or early December.

item.title: Nifty target at 26,200 as BofA tweaks India strategy; upgrades hospitals, telecom, downgrades two-wheelers
item.description: BofA Securities maintained its year-end Nifty target of 26,200, citing improving earnings and easing market risks. It favors large-cap stocks over small- and mid-caps, while warning that volatility, a weak monsoon and fiscal pressures could pose risks.

item.title: IRFC shares: Up 10% in one month but down 32% in 2026! Should you buy and hold PSU stock amid bounce back buzz? Target
item.description: IRFC share price has risen from ₹77.50 to ₹85.25 per share on the NSE in one month

item.title: Tata Power: Q2 renewable gains partly offset by weak solar EPC
item.description: Strong growth in renewable power generation lifted Tata Power’s Q2 operating profit, but weakness in solar EPC and rising debt remain concerns. Planned capacity expansion could unlock valuation upside, though execution risks persist.
